newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ara started as strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ara started as strong buy.

text.p: -- Mexico's Interacciones brokerage initiated coverage of Consorcio Ara on Wednesday with a strong buy recommendation.
-- cited the outlook for the housing sector in Mexico in the next three years.
-- Analyst Jaime Fernandez said Mexico is likely to see accelerated growth in the housing sector because of the 6.0 million home deficit the country suffers.

-- "Ara is in a privileged situation in comparison with its competitors thanks to capital injections of more than $70 million during 1996," he said. "We estimate that by 1998 the company will have duplicated its income over 1996, with annual growth rates over 35 percent."
